question: Where must YIELD signs be used at a roundabout, and may they control the circulatory roadway?
model_answer: Direct Answer: A YIELD sign is mandatory at the entrance to a roundabout to require entering road users to yield the right-of-way to traffic already in the roundabout. YIELD signs must control only the approach roadways — they may not be used to control the circulatory roadway itself. Roundabouts are also the sole exception to the general prohibition on placing YIELD signs on all approaches to an intersection. Standards (mandatory): - "A YIELD sign shall be used to require road users to yield the right-of-way to other traffic at the entrance to a roundabout. YIELD signs at roundabouts shall be used to control the approach roadways and shall not be used to control the circulatory roadway." - "YIELD signs shall not be placed on all of the approaches to an intersection, except at roundabouts." - "The YIELD (R1-2) sign (see Figure 2B-1) shall not be displayed using a changeable message sign." Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Figure 3D-1 shows a roundabout with yield control on each approach roadway (YIELD word markings and yield lines at the entrances), with no yield control within the circulatory roadway itself. - [Image 3] shows the text of Section 2B.10, including the Standard that YIELD signs at roundabouts shall control the approach roadways and shall not control the circulatory roadway. - [Image 4] shows Section 2B.51, describing Roundabout Circulation (R6-5P) plaques placed below the YIELD signs on roundabout approaches, consistent with yield control on approaches only. - [Image 5] shows Section 3D.04, noting that a yield line may be used to indicate the point behind which vehicles are required to yield at the entrance to a roundabout. - [Image 2] shows a roundabout figure page consistent with approach-only yield control markings. Citations: - Section 2B.10 Standard §5 (p.78) - Section 2B.10 Standard §6 (p.78) - Section 2B.05 Standard §2 (p.75) - Figure 3D-1 (p.596) - Page 159 - Page 119 - Page 634
gold_answer: A YIELD sign must control each entering approach roadway. It must not be used to control the circulatory roadway.
